fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans package manifest
fields.description: Identity and compilation configuration declared in the two PropertyGroup blocks of ArgentSea.Orleans.csproj: the .NET target and language settings the package compiles under, its assembly/package version numbers, and the NuGet metadata used when it is packed. The <Description> element is declared twice in the same PropertyGroup (line 9, then again at line 14) with different text; this file does not itself establish which declaration MSBuild resolves at build time, only that both are present.

members.name: TargetFramework
members.description: The .NET target framework moniker the package compiles against.

members.name: ImplicitUsings
members.description: Whether implicit global C# using directives are enabled for the project. MSBuild treats this element's value as a string token, not a boolean bit.

members.name: Nullable
members.description: C# nullable reference-type annotation mode for the project's sources. MSBuild treats this element's value as a string token, not a boolean bit.

members.name: FileVersion
members.description: The compiled assembly file's version resource.

members.name: Title
members.description: The NuGet package title shown on NuGet.
members.notes: 'ArgentSea core library for Microsoft Orleans persistence'

members.name: Description
members.description: The NuGet package description. Declared twice in the same PropertyGroup with different text; this file does not itself establish which declaration MSBuild resolves to.
members.notes: Line 9: 'This library depends on the core ArgentSea library and provides extensions to allow it to provide storage services to Microsoft Orleans..' (doubled trailing full stop as written). Line 14: 'Abstrations which enable ArgentSea to serve as a data provider for Microsoft Orleans.' (misspelling of 'Abstractions' as written).

members.name: PackageIcon
members.description: The packaged icon file name shown on NuGet.

members.name: PackageLicenseExpression
members.description: The SPDX license expression declared for the package.

members.name: GeneratePackageOnBuild
members.description: Whether a NuGet package is produced on every build of the project.

members.name: IncludeSymbols
members.description: Whether a matching .snupkg symbols package is produced alongside the NuGet package.

members.name: SymbolPackageFormat
members.description: The format of the produced symbols package.

evidenceLinks.note: PackageInvariantTests pass against the 2.1.0 project files at commit ea8e9aa3 (ArgentSea.Test 623/623).
